ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure contains a left/upper organic skeleton, three morpholine rings, one benzene ring, two lower morpholine fragments connected to the left sulfur atom, and a separate polysulfur chain on the right; the figure also has curved arrows and a plus sign. The two ends of the right-side polysulfur chain have S-H/HS labels. Reasoning: As required, ignore the curved arrows and the plus sign, and exclude all hydrogen-containing bonds such as S-H. Enumerate heavy-atom bonds by fragment: the upper morpholine ring has 6 bonds; the upper substituted connection part contains an explicit double bond and includes aryl/alkyl connections, totaling 5 bond units, so the upper fragment is 11. The benzene ring is counted as 6 C-C ring connections, which is 6. The two lower morpholine rings each have 6, totaling 12. The N-S connections of the two lower morpholine rings total 2. The S-S bond between the two left sulfur atoms is 1. In the independent polysulfur chain on the right, after excluding S-H, there are 4 S-S bonds. The total is 11 + 6 + 12 + 2 + 1 + 4 = 36.
